parsed.explanation: Thin, dated dossier (latest human-rights reporting 2012; NGO statement 2018). No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented facility, border or document restriction on visitors, and no documented police targeting. Same-sex conduct is decriminalised, and the 2012 report describes relative tolerance, though 2011 documents stigma and a 2010 survey shows low acceptance. Visitor-facing violence is undocumented: the two observations conflict, are unlocated and lack denominators, so they are not weighted as rates. Absent anti-discrimination law, the housing rule and adoption ambiguity are resident-facing and weigh lightly. Thin-data extrapolation from the lack of protections and recourse, the stigma, and the absence of any documented relief places this in the middle band, slightly below neutral because no protective operating regime is documented.
